title: Electrical Upgrades to the GCAFB/Tanker Base/Fire Cache
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF > FOREST SERVICE > Gila National Forest

description:
This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial construction items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. 

  
Solicitation number 127EAX27Q0015 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for Electrical Upgrades to the Grant County Aeriel Fire Base and Tanker Cache on the Gila National Forest. 

  
This project consists of furnishing and installing a complete, code-compliant electrical distribution system to support a designated concrete pad area at the tanker base/fire cache, and the upgrade of an existing electrical/motor control panel serving the retardant pumping system. The completed system shall be suitable for continuous outdoor service in a high-use industrial environment and designed for durability, safety, and future expansion. 

  
This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 238210. The small business size standard is $19M. This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency.
